## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Relevant suite passes locally (`bundle exec rake test` / `npm test` / `cargo test`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
